control_flow: followInTheDark: if RLIGHT is below 60, check LLIGHT below 45, then the line tracker above 95, otherwise avoidWalls; if RLIGHT is not below 60, call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if LLIGHT is below 70, check LEFT obstacle (turn right 20°), then RIGHT obstacle (turn left 20°), otherwise driveInTheDark; if LLIGHT is not below 70, call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70, drive forward at 30 %; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if FRONT obstacle is seen, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left (10 %, 40 %); otherwise curve right (40 %, 10 %).
